title: Karbobala Naseeb se jaana naseeb ho
body:
Uthhe hai haath khudaya isi dua ke liye
Naseeb Ho Safar e ishq karbala ke liye
Karbala, karbala..(2)
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho..(3) Phir laut kar waha'n se..(2)
Na aana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ankho'n ko jab bhi ashk bahana naseeb ho..(2)
Aale nabi ke ghum ka bahana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Aisa dar e Hussain pe sajda ho aakhri..(2) Phir mujhko apna sar na uthana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Parwardigaar thokarein dar dar ki kab talak..(2)
Ab mustaqil Najaf mein thikana Naseeb ho Phir laut kar waha'n se na aana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jaisa mila naseeb se ummul baneen ko..(2)
Ab kya, ab kya..
ab kya kisi ko aisa gharana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mehshar yeh arzoo hai ke, be ghuslo be kafan..(2)
Karbobala ki teh mei samaana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aa'nsoo gire the baali sakina ke jis jagah..(2)
Apna waha'n pe khoon bahana naseeb ho Phir laut kar waha'n se na aana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ye kehke shaah nikle mazaar e Rasool se..(2)
Pardes mein Kafan mujhe Nana Naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Haaye, Asghar hai mere haath bandhe kehti thi Rabab..(2)
Kaise tumhe gale se lagana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Mashkeeza leke Roza e Abbas ke Qareeb..(2)
Sab Zairo'n ko paani pilana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Ek sar burida laashe ne bacchi ko di dua..(2)
Zindaa'n se tujhko laut ke aana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Nazdeek e khaima gaah sakina ki yaad mein..(2)
Shaam e garibaa'n shamma jalana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Sajjad shaam tak yahi karte rahe dua..(2)
Chadar..
Chadar mujhe phupi ko udhana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Aye kaash phir se Mir takallum faraat par..(2)
Mahdi..
Mahdi ko sheh ka nauha sunana naseeb ho.. Phir laut kar waha'n se na aana naseeb ho
<<MINI>>
Karbobala Naseeb se jaana Naseeb Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala, Karbala, Karbala, Karbala, Karbala... Karbala..
